messages.content: Help me create an exponential decay scoring function for an Elasticsearch query, targeting the 'timestamp' field, with an origin point of 'now', a scale of '10d', an offset of '2d', and a decay factor of 0.5?

function.name: ScoreFunctionBuilders_exponentialDecayFunction
function.description: Creates an ExponentialDecayFunctionBuilder which is used to score documents with a function that decays exponentially from a certain origin. Note that the provided function is in Java 8 SDK syntax.

fieldName.description: The name of the field on which to apply the function. This is Java String type parameter in string representation.

origin.description: The point of origin from which decay starts. This parameter can be of any type of Java object in string representation.

scale.description: Defines how quickly the function decays. This parameter can be of any type of Java object in string representation.

offset.description: The offset from the origin before decay starts. Default null This parameter can be of any type of Java object in string representation.

decay.description: The decay factor, must be between 0 and 1. This is Java double type parameter in string representation.
